items.title: Fast on phones
items.text: Most of your customers look you up on their phone. Your site loads in a blink, even on patchy mobile data.

items.title: Found locally
items.text: Set up for local search and your Google Business Profile, so people nearby find you when they search.

items.title: Easy to update
items.text: Send me a quick message for changes, or add a simple editor and post your own news.

items.title: No monthly fees
items.text: Pay once for your site. After that you only pay when you ask for a change.
